reviewNotes: ADMIT-BACKSTAGE. Current Cyta soeasy FAQ and terms establish 365-day line validity, EUR 5 as the lowest listed recharge that grants another 365 days, a 7-day incoming-only window plus 15 additional days before cancellation, and online card top-up even while abroad. Current law-backed provider terms require prepaid SIM/eSIM identification; non-EU customers can use a passport, with an in-store path for those without one. The legacy unresolved-validity/KYC state is withdrawn; China-specific OTP reliability remains unverified.

events.outcome: Current Cyta material resolves the legacy gap: EUR 5, 10, 20, 35 or 50 credit top-ups each grant 365 days; after the 365-day deadline outgoing service stops, followed by 7 days incoming-only and 15 additional days before number cancellation.

data.acquisitionSummary: Cyta sells soeasy as prepaid physical SIM/eSIM. Current terms require owner/user identification before activation. Current provider materials support online or store identification and passport-based identification for non-EU customers.

keep.action: Top up EUR 5 or more before the 365-day validity deadline. Each listed credit top-up value grants 365 days. After expiry, outgoing calls stop, then 7 days incoming-only plus 15 additional days remain before cancellation.

data.chinaActivation: Current provider flow requires prepaid identification before activation. Top-up can be performed while abroad, but China-first activation and end-to-end China acquisition are not established.
data.kyc: Identification is mandatory under Cyta's current prepaid terms. EU customers may use ID or passport; non-EU customers may use passport, with an in-store path documented for non-EU customers without a passport.
data.payment: Online top-up supports Visa, Mastercard, Maestro and American Express through My Cyta or as a visitor without login; Cyta states top-up can be done while abroad.
data.tariffSummary: EUR 5 minimum listed credit top-up grants 365 days; 7-day incoming-only window plus 15 days before cancellation; identification required.
guideSteps: Acquire a soeasy SIM/eSIM and complete Cyta's prepaid identification flow.
Top up at least EUR 5 before the 365-day validity deadline; remote web top-up is available.
Do not plan around the 7+15 day post-expiry recovery window as the normal maintenance interval.
